'''Lantadyme''' is a [[Farming]] plant that grows after planting a [[lantadyme seed]] in a [[herb patch]], requiring level 73 Farming. It takes 80 minutes to grow, in 4 stages of 20 minutes each, and when fully grown can be harvested for [[grimy lantadyme]].

Lantadyme can become diseased while growing, and can be cured using [[plant cure]]. If not cured, it will eventually become [[dead herbs]].

As with all herb patch crops, nearby gardeners will '''not''' watch over growing lantadyme.

The yield is [[variable crop yield|variable]], using the "harvest lives" mechanic with a minimum of 3 lives. The number of lives can be increased by 1 using [[compost]], 2 using [[supercompost]], or 3 with [[ultracompost]]. The chance to save harvest lives is improved with higher Farming level, and can be further improved using [[magic secateurs]], the [[Farming cape]], or having a growing [[Attas plant]]. Additionally, completing the [[Kandarin Diary]] will improve the yield in the [[Catherby]] herb patch, and the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary]] will improve the yield in [[Hosidius]] and the [[Farming Guild]].

===Average harvest yield===
Lantadyme has a minimum of 3 [[Farming#Variable crop yield|harvest lives]], increasing by 1 for each tier of [[compost]] used (for a maximum of 6 when using [[ultracompost]]). While harvesting lantadyme, there is a chance to not consume a harvest life dependent on the player's Farming level. This chance scales from 25.4% at level 1 to 31.6% at level 99, interpolating linearly in between.
